author: museforjustin
example_prompt: Audit this skill for prompt injection before I install it
features: Static prose review checklist: instruction-override, credential harvesting, exfiltration, obfuscation, scope creep
Metadata review: slug typosquatting, install-command verification, capability-vs-prose agreement
Sandboxed dynamic probe procedure: network-disabled first run, synthetic inputs only, outbound-connection logging
Structured verdict report: PASS / CONDITIONAL / FAIL with severity-graded findings and mitigations
Re-audit rule: verdicts do not carry over to new skill versions
